name: Spirit
intro: Spirit was built to explore Gusev crater for 90 Mars days. It kept going for more than six years and found signs of ancient hot springs. Today it sits stuck in soft sand at a spot called Troy.
whyLeft: In 2009 its wheels broke through a crust into soft sand at Troy. Stuck at a bad angle, it could not tilt its solar panels toward the winter Sun, and its last signal came on 22 March 2010.
repurpose: A helper robot with a shovel could dig out its wheels. Even stuck, Spirit was useful: NASA turned it into a science station, and its wobbles helped measure the inside of Mars.

hotspots.title: The dead wheel
hotspots.text: In 2006 the motor in Spirit’s right-front wheel stopped working, so Spirit drove backwards, dragging it. The stuck wheel scraped up bright soil that turned out to be almost pure silica, a sign of ancient hot springs.

photo.alt: A bright white stripe of churned-up soil in reddish ground.
photo.caption: The bright stripe of nearly pure silica that Spirit’s dragging wheel churned up.

hotspots.title: Stuck at Troy
hotspots.text: In May 2009 Spirit’s wheels broke through a thin crust into soft sand. Engineers tested escape moves with a twin rover in a sandbox on Earth for months, but Spirit could not get out.

source.label: NASA JPL: NASA ends attempts to contact Spirit

photo.caption: Spirit’s view from Troy in 2009, soon after its wheels sank into the soft sand.

hotspots.title: Solar panels
hotspots.text: Stuck at a bad angle, Spirit could not tilt these panels toward the low winter Sun. Its last signal reached Earth on 22 March 2010.

source.label: NASA JPL: NASA ends attempts to contact Spirit

hotspots.title: The camera mast
hotspots.text: Spirit’s cameras looked out from this mast. Early on, a memory problem made it reboot over and over; engineers fixed it by radio, from more than 150 million kilometers away.

hotspots.title: The rock grinder
hotspots.text: The tool on the end of this arm ground into rocks to see inside them. Spirit found rocks and soils that had been changed by water long ago.

funFact: Spirit made one of its biggest discoveries by accident: its broken wheel, dragging behind it, dug up the white silica soil.
